11100.meaning1: full of people; crowded with people; packed with people; (comm) endless people

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idaṃ, bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca bāhujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhabyūhaṃ.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti? evaṃ, bhante, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti.

11101.meaning1: full of supernatural beings; packed with daemons

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, devānaṃ āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī iddhā c'eva hoti phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇayakkhā ca subhikkhā ca, evam'eva kho, ānanda, kusāvatī rājadhānī iddhā c'eva ahosi phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.

11102.synonym: kakkhaḷa, caṇḍa, caṇḍī, rudda, ruddha, ludda, verambha
11102.commentary: (SNa) ākiṇṇaluddo'ti bahupāpo gāḷhapāpo vā, tasmā na vuccati. (JAa) ākiṇṇaluddo'ti gāḷhaluddo. (SNt) ākiṇṇaluddo'ti ākiṇṇo hutvā kakkhaḷo. ten'āha bahupāpo'ti-ādi.

examples.text: ākiṇṇaluddo puriso, dhāticelaṃ'va makkhito, tasmiṃ me vacanaṃ n'atthi, tvañ'c'ārahāmi vattave.

11104.meaning1: living crowded together; cramped living conditions

examples.text: dubbhikkhe kho pana manussā yena subhikkhaṃ tena saṅkamanti. tattha saṅgaṇikavihāro hoti ākiṇṇavihāro. saṅgaṇikavihāre kho pana sati ākiṇṇavihāre na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ, na sukarāni araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevituṃ.

11105.meaning1: stirs up; heaps up; kicks up
11105.commentary: (SNa) bhiyyo ākirate rajan'ti atirekaṃ upari kilesarajaṃ ākirati. (DHPa) bhiyyo ākirate rajan'ti abbhantare vijjamānaṃ rāgaraj'ādiṃ evarūpo samaṇadhammo apanetuṃ na sakkoti, atha kho tassa upari aparam'pi rāgaraj'ādiṃ ākiratī'ti attho.

examples.text: kayirā ce kayirāth'enaṃ, daḷham'enaṃ parakkame, sithilo hi paribbājo, bhiyyo ākirate rajaṃ.
atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo taṃ ñātidāsiṃ etadavoca, sac'etaṃ, bhagini, chaḍḍanīyadhammaṃ, idha me patte ākirā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tahaṃ tahaṃ olokentā piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti, ākirante'pi atikkante'pi na jānanti
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, aññesaṃ dento omasati, aññassa bhājane ākiranto omasati, uttaribhaṅge, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

11108.commentary: (CPa) sakaṭāhena ākirin'ti iminā attano kiñci'pi asesetvā dinnabhāvaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: pavanā ābhataṃ paṇṇaṃ, atelañ'ca aloṇikaṃ, mama dvāre ṭhitaṃ disvā, sakaṭāhena ākiriṃ.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpak'antevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya
santi, bhikkhave, jātarūpassa oḷārikā upakkilesā paṃsuvālukā sakkharakaṭhalā. tam'enaṃ paṃsudhovako vā paṃsudhovak'antevāsī vā doṇiyaṃ ākiritvā dhovati sandhovati niddhovati.
yo vāruṇī addhano akiñcano, pipāso pivaṃ papāgato, udakam'iva iṇaṃ vigāhati, ākulaṃ kāhiti khippam'attano.

taṇhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi jāliniṃ saritaṃ visaṭaṃ visattikaṃ, yāya ayaṃ loko uddhasto pariyonaddho tant'ākulakajāto gulāguṇṭhikajāto muñjapabbajabhūto apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.

11114.commentary: (DNt) tantam'eva vā ākulaṃ tantākulaṃ, tantākulaṃ viya jātā bhūtā'ti tan'tākulajātā.

examples.text: atha kho sambahulā nānātitthiyasāvakā devaputtā asamo ca sahali ca nīko ca ākoṭako ca vegabbhari ca māṇavagāmiyo ca abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ veḷuvanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu
atha kho ākoṭako devaputto nānātitthiye ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
evaṃ vutte, bhante, rattapāṇi rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ kho te, makkaṭacchāpako raṅgakkhamo hi kho, no ākoṭanakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo'ti.

11122.meaning1: able to take a beating; can be pounded
11122.commentary: (MNa) ākoṭṭanakkhamo'ti saviññāṇakassa tāva ākoṭṭanaphalake ṭhapetvā kucchiyaṃ ākoṭitassa kucchi bhijjati, karīsaṃ nikkhamati. sesī ākoṭitassa sīsaṃ bhijjati, mattaluṅgaṃ nikkhamati. aviññāṇako khaṇḍakhaṇḍitaṃ gacchati. tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhante, rattapāṇi rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ kho te, makkaṭacchāpako raṅgakkhamo hi kho, no ākoṭanakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo'ti.

11124.meaning1: makes beat; causes to pound; makes pummel

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
atha kho āyasmā nando bhagavato mātucchāputto ākoṭitapaccākoṭitāni cīvarāni pārupitvā akkhīni añjetvā acchaṃ pattaṃ gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
sappaṭibhayaṃ nāma ārāme ārām'ūpacāre corehi manussā hatā dissanti, viluttā dissanti, ākoṭitā dissanti.

11127.meaning1: pounded back and front; beaten this way and that

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā nando bhagavato mātucchāputto ākoṭitapaccākoṭitāni cīvarāni pārupitvā akkhīni añjetvā acchaṃ pattaṃ gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi, icchām'ahaṃ, samma rattapāṇi, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pīt'āvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rajitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye kiṭṭhasambādhe gopālako gāvo rakkheyya. so tā gāvo tato tato daṇḍena ākoṭeyya paṭikoṭeyya sannirundheyya sannivāreyya.

11130.meaning1: having beaten; having pounded; having pummelled

examples.text: jivhaṃ baḷisena gahetvā ārajay'ārajayā vihanantī'ti tattha asipattavane vegena dhāvitvā patitānaṃ musāvādīnaṃ nerayikānaṃ nirayapālā jivhaṃ baḷisena nikkaḍḍhitvā yathā manussā allacammaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pattharitvā khilehi ākoṭenti, evaṃ ākoṭetvā pharasūhi phāletvā phāletvā ekam'ekaṃ koṭiṃ chindetvā vihananti, chinnachinnā koṭi punappunaṃ samuṭṭhāti.
atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro, tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno āḷindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
atha kho bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi.
tesaṃgahaṇena samāsa-taddhit'ākhyāta-kitakānaṃ vibhattipaccayapad'akkhar'āgamā ca lopā honti. vāsiṭṭho, venateyyo
idha ākhyāte aniddiṭṭhesu sādhanesu kvaci dhātu vibhatti paccayānaṃ dīgha viparīt'ādesa lop'āgama'icc'etāni kāriyāni jinavacan'ānurūpāni kātabbāni.
iti ākhyātakappe paṭhamo kaṇḍo.
iti ākhyātakappe catuttho kaṇḍo. ākhyātakappo niṭṭhito.

yaṃ pan'etaṃ, evaṃ me sutan'tiādikaṃ nidānaṃ, tattha evan'ti nipātapadaṃ. me'tiādīni nāmapadāni. sāvatthiyaṃ viharatī'ti ettha vī'ti upasaggapadaṃ, haratī'ti ākhyātapadan'ti iminā tāva nayena padavibhāgo veditabbo.
santi, bhante, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kesamuttaṃ āgacchanti. te sakaṃ'y'eva vādaṃ dīpenti jotenti, parappavādaṃ pana khuṃsenti vambhenti paribhavanti omakkhiṃ karonti.
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū paccattaññ'eva satiṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti, kin'ti anāgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī āgaccheyyuṃ āgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī phāsuṃ vihareyyun'ti
atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo

11145.synonym: abbajati, upanivattati, pacceti, paṭikkamati, punarāgamati, punupeti

examples.text: pañcakāmaguṇike rāge pariññāte n'atthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto ariyasāvako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyya
sā ce tato cutā itthattaṃ āgacchati, sā yattha yattha paccājāyati dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya, daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā app'esakkhā ca.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, same bhūmibhāge pokkharaṇī caturaṃsā ālibaddhā pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā. tam'enaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āliṃ muñceyya, āgaccheyya udakan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

11147.synonym: okkamati, kamati, karīyati, niccharati, byeti, vattati, sambhavati

examples.text: satt'ime, bhikkhave, dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanaṃ āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. katame satta?
kathaṃ byākaramānā… dhammassa c'ānudhammaṃ byākareyyāma, na ca koci sahadhammiko vād'ānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyā'ti?
addasā kho aggikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ.
so araññato āgacchante mālākāre disvā thokaṃ thokaṃ phāṇitakhaṇḍaṃ datvā uḷuṅkena pānīyaṃ adāsi, te c'assa ek'ekaṃ pupphamuṭṭhiṃ adaṃsu.

11151.commentary: (THIa) ayācito tat'āgacchī'ti tato paralokato kenaci ayācito idha āgacchi. āgato'ti'pi pāḷi, so ev'attho.

examples.text: ayācito tat'āgacchi, n'ānuññāto ito gato, kutoci nūna āgantvā, vasitvā katip'āhakaṃ, ito'pi aññena gato, tato'p'aññena gacchati.

11152.meaning1: could come; would come along; could approach; would arrive

examples.text: dūrato'pi kho mayaṃ, āvuso, āgaccheyyāma āyasmato sāriputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa attham'aññātuṃ
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū paccattaññ'eva satiṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti, kin'ti anāgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī āgaccheyyuṃ āgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī phāsuṃ vihareyyun'ti
saṭṭh'ete devanikāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino, nām'anvayena āgañchuṃ, ye c'aññe sadisā saha.
daddallamānā āgañchuṃ, taṇhā ca aratī ragā, tā tattha panudī satthā, tūlaṃ bhaṭṭhaṃ'va māluto'ti.
yo ve parakulaṃ gantvā, bhutvāna sucibhojanaṃ, āgataṃ nappaṭipūjeti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
cirappavāsiṃ purisaṃ, dūrato sotthim'āgataṃ, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, abhinandanti āgataṃ.
idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilāno hoti. so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya, ahañ'hi gilāno, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan'ti.
cirappavāsiṃ purisaṃ, dūrato sotthim'āgataṃ, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, abhinandanti āgataṃ.
eta'r'ahi vā paccuppannam'addhānaṃ ajjhattaṃ kathaṃkathī hoti, ahaṃ nu kho'smi? no nu kho'smi? kiṃ nu kho'smi? kathaṃ nu kho'smi? ayaṃ nu kho satto kuto āgato? so kuhiṃ gāmī bhavissatī'ti?
muṇḍo virūpo abhisāpam'āgato, kapālahattho'va kulesu bhikkhasu, yuñjassu satthuvacane mah'esino, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
taṃ buddhaṃ asitaṃ tādiṃ, akuhaṃ gaṇim'āgataṃ, bahūnam'idha baddhānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, idān'eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi, ayam'pi kira dhammo sutt'āgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī'ti.
āgatāni kho, tāta uttara, amhākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsa-mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dve'y'eva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.

11159.commentary: (ANa) āgataṃ bhāraṃ na vahatī'ti thero samāno tam'eva dasavidhaṃ bhāraṃ attanā vā akaronto paraṃ vā asamādapento āgataṃ bhāraṃ na vahati nāma. (ANa) āgataṃ pañhan'ti pucchitaṃ pañhaṃ.

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, bālā. katame dve? yo ca anāgataṃ bhāraṃ vahati, yo ca āgataṃ bhāraṃ na vahati. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bālā'ti.

katamehi pañcahi? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti, sīlasampadāya kathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti, attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti, samādhisampadāya kathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti, attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, paññāsampadāya kathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti

11160.meaning1: arriving at work; reaching what is to be done

examples.text: vipassanā hi tīṇi lakkhaṇāni upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. maggo vipassanāya āgatakiccaṃ sādhetī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. phalaṃ tathalakkhaṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ.

11161.meaning1: (gram) (of text) fact of having been handed down

11164.meaning1: who has reached the fruit; epithet of a stream-enterer
11164.commentary: (VINa) tattha āgataṃ phalaṃ assā'ti āgataphalā paṭiladdhasot'āpattiphalā'ti attho. (ANa) ariyaphalaṃ assa āgatan'ti āgataphalo.

examples.text: saddheyyavacasā nāma āgataphalā abhisametāvinī viññātasāsanā.
yo so, bhante, ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so katamena vihārena bahulaṃ viharatī'ti?

11166.meaning1: road on which one came; way one came

examples.text: gahapatiko rathā otaritvā kesesu gahetvā nāmetvā kapparapahārehi koṭṭetvā gale gahetvā āgatamagga-abhimukhaṃ khipitvā pakkāmi

11167.meaning1: we have come; we have arrived
11167.commentary: (SNa) āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayan'ti evaṃ samāgate devakāye disvā mayam'pi imaṃ dhammasamūhaṃ āgatā.

examples.text: mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ, devakāyā samāgatā, āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ, dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti.
āgatā samaṇā imaṃ saṅgh'ārāmaṃ so'yaṃ āgatasamaṇo, saṅgh'ārāmo.

11169.commentary: (ANa) āgataviso na ghoraviso'ti yassa visaṃ āgacchati, ghoraṃ pana na hoti, cirakālaṃ na pīḷeti.

examples.text: katame cattāro? āgataviso na ghoraviso, ghoraviso na āgataviso, āgataviso ca ghoraviso ca, n'ev'āgataviso na ghoraviso, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvisā. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvis'ūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.

11170.meaning1: area that is come to; territory arrived at

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsaṃ pokkharaṇīnaṃ tīre nhāpake purise ṭhapeyyaṃ, ye āgat'āgataṃ janaṃ nhāpessantī'ti.

11172.meaning1: who is an heir to the scriptures; who has received the texts
11172.meaning2: who has learnt the 4 collections of the Suttapiṭaka

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asukasmiṃ nāma āvāse sambahulā therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgat'āgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā. tesaṃ me therānaṃ sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
tatr'āp'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, n'eva āgatiṃ vadāmi, na gatiṃ, na ṭhitiṃ, na cutiṃ, na upapattiṃ. appatiṭṭhaṃ, appavattaṃ, anārammaṇam'ev'etaṃ. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho ahaññ'ev'eko jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā jarādhammā jaraṃ anatītā'ti.

11174.meaning1: coming and going; arriving and departing
11174.commentary: (Sna) āgatigati na hotī'ti paṭisandhivasena āgati nāma, cutivasena gamanaṃ nāma na hoti.

examples.text: nissitassa calitaṃ, anissitassa calitaṃ n'atthi. calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati nati na hoti. natiyā asati āgatigati na hoti. āgatigatiyā asati cut'ūpapāto na hoti. cut'ūpapāte asati n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
dūrato āgato'si sabhiya, pañhe pucchituṃ abhikaṅkhamāno, tes'antakaro bhavāmi pañhe te puṭṭho, anupubbaṃ anudhammaṃ byākaromi te.
ye ca rūp'ūpagā sattā, ye ca arūpaṭṭhāyino, nirodhaṃ appajānantā, āgantāro punabbhavaṃ.

11178.commentary: (ANa) āgantāro itthattan'ti itthabhāvaṃ kām'āvacara-pañcakkhandha-bhāvam'eva āgantāro, n'eva tatr'ūpapattikā na uparūpapattikā honti.

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacce sattā tamhā kāyā cutā āgāmino honti āgantāro itthattaṃ?

11179.construction:
ā + √gam + tar > tu + ka
āgantu + ka

examples.text: āgantukassa dānaṃ deti, gamikassa dānaṃ deti, gilānassa dānaṃ deti, dubbhikkhe dānaṃ deti, yāni tāni navasassāni navaphalāni tāni paṭhamaṃ sīlavantesu patiṭṭhāpeti.
āvuso, āgantuka kuṭumbikassa te gehe bhattaṃ bhuñjanato varataraṃ mīḷhaṃ khādituṃ… kuṭumbikena dinnasāṭakanivāsanato varataraṃ naggena vicarituṃ

11180.construction:
ā + √gam + tar > tu + ka
āgantu + ka

examples.text: bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmetī'ti āgantukakathaṃ otārento purimakathaṃ bahiddhā apanāmeti. tatr'idaṃ vatthu, bhikkhū kira sannipatitvā ekaṃ daharaṃ, āvuso, tvaṃ imañ'c'imañ'ca āpattiṃ āpanno'ti āhaṃsu. so āha, bhante, nāgadīpaṃ gato'mhī'ti.

11181.construction:
ā + √gam + tar > tu + ka
āgantu + ka
11181.commentary: (ANa) āgantukehī'ti asahajātehi pacchā javanakkhaṇe uppajjanakehi. upakkilesehī'ti rāg'ādīhi upakkiliṭṭhattā upakkiliṭṭhaṃ nāmā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: pabhassaram'idaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ. tañ'ca kho āgantukehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhan'ti.
āgantukassa bhattaṃ āgantukabhattaṃ, methunā apeto methun'āpeto, corā bhayaṃ corabhayaṃ, rañño putto rājaputto, dhaññānaṃ rāsi dhaññarāsi, rūpe saññā rūpasaññā, saṃsāre dukkhaṃ saṃsāradukkhaṃ.

11185.commentary: (SNa) āgantuk'āgāran'ti puññ'atthikehi nagaramajjhe kataṃ āgantukagharaṃ, yattha rājarājamah'āmattehi'pi sakkā hoti nivāsaṃ upagantuṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āgantuk'āgāraṃ. tattha puratthimāya'pi disāya āgantvā vāsaṃ kappenti, pacchimāya'pi disāya āgantvā vāsaṃ kappenti, uttarāya'pi disāya āgantvā vāsaṃ kappenti, dakkhiṇāya'pi disāya āgantvā vāsaṃ kappenti.

11186.meaning1: wanting to come; wishing to return

examples.text: gacchatha, tātā, pabbatapādaṃ pavisitvā jīvantā subhikkhakāle mama santikaṃ āgantu'kāmā āgacchatha, anāgantu'kāmā tattha tatth'eva jīvathā'ti.

11187.meaning1: to come; to approach; to visit

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhaggava, sunakkhattaṃ licchaviputtaṃ etadavocaṃ, abhabbo kho, sunakkhatta, acelo pāthikaputto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhībhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.
puratthimāya disāya āgantvā sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ taṃ dovārikaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, kahaṃ, bho purisa, imassa nagarassa nagarassāmī'ti? so evaṃ vadeyya, eso, bhante, majjhe siṅghāṭake nisinno'ti.
bhikkhussa ṭhit'okāsaṃ vā nisinn'okāsaṃ vā nipann'okāsaṃ vā āgantvā mantentaṃ ukkāsitabbaṃ, vijānāpetabbaṃ, no ce ukkāseyya vā vijānāpeyya vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

11189.commentary: (ANa) āgat'āgamā'ti dīgh'ādīsu yo koci āgamo āgato etesan'ti āgat'āgamā.

examples.text: tassa bhavanti vattāro, iṅgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro.

idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asukasmiṃ nāma āvāse sambahulā therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgat'āgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā. tesaṃ me therānaṃ sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
khurapariyantena ce'pi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, n'atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, n'atthi pāpassa āgamo.
tesaṃgahaṇena samāsa-taddhit'ākhyāta-kitakānaṃ vibhattipaccayapad'akkhar'āgamā ca lopā honti. vāsiṭṭho, venateyyo
ākhyāta-sāgaram'ath'ajjatanī-taraṅ'gaṃ, dhātujjalaṃ vikaraṇ'āgamakālamīnaṃ, lop'ānubandh'ariyam'attha-vibhāga-tīraṃ, dhīrā taranti kavino puthubuddhināvā.
dīgham'āyu manussānaṃ, na naṃ hīḷe suporiso, careyya khīramatto'va, n'atthi maccussa āgamo'ti.
etu kho, bhante, bhagavā. svāgataṃ, bhante, bhagavato. cirassaṃ kho, bhante, bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi, yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya
ehi kho, mārisa, svāgataṃ, mārisa! cirassaṃ kho, mārisa, imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya.
yassa darathajā na santi keci, oraṃ āgamanāya paccayāse, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

te upakaṭṭhāya vass'ūpanāyikāya pañcasatatāpase himavantato āgantvā nagare bhikkhāya carante disvā pasīditvā nisīdāpetvā bhojetvā paṭiññaṃ gahetvā cattāro māse attano santike vasāpetvā puna vassāratte āgaman'atthāya paṭijānāpetvā uyyojesuṃ.

11196.meaning1: conscious of the future consequences; with thought of the results
11196.meaning2: with a belief in future consequences
11196.meaningLit: having a view about what is coming
11196.commentary: (ANa) āgamanadiṭṭhiko'ti anāgatabhavassa paccayo bhavissatī'ti kammañ'ca vipākañ'ca saddahitvā detī'ti.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisadānaṃ deti? idha, bhikkhave, sappuriso sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ deti, sahatthā dānaṃ deti, cittīkatvā dānaṃ deti, anapaviṭṭhaṃ dānaṃ deti, āgamanadiṭṭhiko dānaṃ deti.

11197.meaning1: road by which one arrives; path by which it comes

11199.commentary: (THIa) orambhā'gamanīyānī'ti rūp'ārūpadhātuto heṭṭhābhāge kāmadhātuyaṃ manussajīvassa hitāni upakārāni tattha paṭisandhiyā paccayabhāvato. ma-kāro padasandhikaro. oram'āgamanīyānī'ti pāḷi, so ev'attho.

examples.text: saṃyojanāni etāni, pajahitvāna bhikkhunī, oram'āgamanīyāni, na'y'idaṃ punarehisi.
